mapper.insert: MERGE INTO TBL_POLICY ( POLICY_SOURCE, POLICY_EXTERNAL_ID, POLICY_NAME, POLICY_DESCRIPTION, POLICY_KEYWORDS, POLICY_LARGE_CATEGORY, POLICY_MEDIUM_CATEGORY, POLICY_SUPPORT_CONTENT, POLICY_ORGANIZATION_NAME, POLICY_APPLICATION_METHOD, POLICY_APPLICATION_URL, POLICY_SUBMISSION_DOCUMENTS, POLICY_REFERENCE_URL, POLICY_MIN_AGE, POLICY_MAX_AGE, POLICY_ADDITIONAL_CONDITION, POLICY_REGION_CODES, POLICY_STATUS ) KEY (POLICY_SOURCE, POLICY_EXTERNAL_ID) VALUES ( #{policySource}, #{policyExternalId}, #{policyName}, #{policyDescription}, #{policyKeywords}, #{policyLargeCategory}, #{policyMediumCategory}, #{policySupportContent}, #{policyOrganizationName}, #{policyApplicationMethod}, #{policyApplicationUrl}, #{policySubmissionDocuments}, #{policyReferenceUrl}, #{policyMinAge}, #{policyMaxAge}, #{policyAdditionalCondition}, #{policyRegionCodes}, #{policyStatus} )
